default: Markdown enabled with basic profile and typography enabled
effect: supplies Markdown parser and typography defaults for text elements that request markup
precedence: recognized nested members are read independently; element typography overrides the host typography default; absent members retain defaults

namespace: nested host Markdown gate and profile
effect: selects whether requested Markdown is parsed and whether basic or extended grammar is available
precedence: host Markdown gate and profile apply to all requesting labels; local markup requests do not override a disabled host gate

effect: false displays requested Markdown as source text with a localized refusal diagnostic while preserving independent interpolation
precedence: explicit host false takes precedence over a local markup request; absent or true enables the selected profile

effect: extended enables headings, blockquotes, tables and fenced code; unknown names safely fall back to basic
precedence: host profile determines grammar when Markdown is enabled; disabled Markdown gate still wins

effect: enables or suppresses themed typography wrapping around rendered text
precedence: same-key local text-element typography option overrides the host default, including explicit false
